name: loom
description: 52 open models (Qwen, gemma, gpt-oss, Llama, LFM, Nemotron, ...) on AMD Loom kernels, installed with gufo model install

releases.notes: 52 loom-fun packages as Gufo models (gufo model install <id>, then --model <id>); the preset each package publishes for the GPU; packages built for another Loom SDK are refused at load. Loom SDK 0.2.0 (hrx-system v0.2.0) through libloom_text_embed, which the extension's nix/runtime.nix (or flake output #runtime) builds and the install finds on CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH. Built on Gufo ec6d3d07 (after 0.35.0) and 029a156.
